facts.fact: INTIC published the draft Regulation on Cloud Computing Service Providers (version of 23 December 2024) for public consultation, opened 24 February 2025 and running to 30 March 2025, together with a companion data-centre regulation draft; the opening day is inferred from the consultation window.
